classification.difficultyReason: Determine the conversion factor from the graph and use the equation to convert an amount beyond the plotted range.

content.prompt:
The graph shows the conversion between US dollars, $\$$, and euros, €.

How many euros is $\$300$ US?

spec.description: Euros on the horizontal axis and USD on the vertical axis. Labelled ticks are every 10 units, with intermediate ticks and grid lines every 5 units. Both axes and the blue conversion line have arrowheads. The origin has no label. Axis titles sit outside the numeric ticks.
spec.mathematics: D = 1.2E; the line passes through (0,0) and (50,60). The grid spans 0 to 50 euros and 0 to 60 USD; the line continues beyond (50,60).
spec.answerVisibility: The supplied conversion graph is always visible; the calculation and final conversion answer are answer-only.
